text: @zhtx2026/dsh-pdf 是面向 DSH 的 PDF 解析插件，提供给 agent 调用的 PDF 工具。它在宿主端注册 pdf_info、pdf_extract_text 和 pdf_render_page，并注入使用指引。用户可查看页数、页面尺寸、元数据和字体内嵌状态，按页提取文字及坐标，也能把页面渲染为 PNG；内嵌字体文件使用 pdfjs，未内嵌字体时切换系统字体渲染路径。适合整理 PDF 文档、读取中文原理图和查看页面图像。使用时提供本地 PDF 路径；无需 API Key 或外部账号，渲染结果写入本机文件。

@zhtx2026/dsh-pdf adds PDF tools to DSH: inspect page metadata and fonts, extract text with optional coordinates, or render a page to PNG. It chooses pdfjs or system fonts based on embedded fonts, helping read local PDFs and Chinese schematics. No API key is needed; PNGs are saved locally.
想查看 PDF 有几页、页面尺寸和包含哪些字体。
帮我从 PDF 文件里提取每一页的文字。
我需要只读取 PDF 中指定页的内容。
提取 PDF 文字时能不能同时返回每行坐标？
把 PDF 的某一页转换成 PNG 图片方便查看。
有些原理图的中文字体没有嵌入，想正确读出文字。
I need to inspect a PDF’s page count, metadata, and font embedding.
Can I extract text from a selected PDF page with line positions?
Render one page of a local PDF as a PNG image for review.
Help me read Chinese text from a schematic PDF with missing embedded fonts.
pdf_info 可查看本地 PDF 的页数、每页尺寸、文档元数据和字体列表，并标出每种字体是否内嵌。调用时传入 PDF 绝对路径，结果返回结构化信息。
pdf_extract_text 按页提取本地 PDF 的文字，可指定页码并选择返回逐行坐标和字号。字体均内嵌时使用 pdfjs 文本层，否则走内置提取器。
pdf_render_page 将本地 PDF 指定页渲染为 PNG，可设置缩放、输出目录和渲染引擎；默认按字体内嵌情况选择 pdfjs 或系统字体渲染器，并返回图片路径。
插件挂载时向 DSH agent 注入 PDF 工具使用说明，并通过宿主工具服务注册三个 PDF 工具；卸载时清理各工具注册项。
渲染页面会在本机创建输出目录并写入 PNG；纯图片扫描件没有可提取的文字层，提取结果可能为空。

@zhtx2026/dsh-pdf README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @zhtx2026/dsh-pdf
```

Or from a local checkout during development:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add link:<path-to-repo>
```

Then restart DSH (or open a new session) — the three tools and an agent guidance block become available.

@zhtx2026/dsh-pdf README · Tools：| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `pdf_info` | Page count, page sizes (pt), document metadata, and the font list with per-font `embedded` flags. |
| `pdf_extract_text` | Extracts text per page; optional `page` and `withPosition` (per-line x/y coordinates + font size). |
| `pdf_render_page` | Renders one page to a PNG (local file) with configurable `scale`/`outDir`; engine auto-selection. |

@zhtx2026/dsh-pdf README · Why a custom renderer?：pdfjs-dist cannot render text in PDFs whose fonts are not embedded and lack a
`ToUnicode` map — the classic case is **JLC EDA / EasyEDA schematic exports**
(SimSun/SimHei `Type0` fonts with `UniGB-UCS2-H` encoding): pdfjs emits
`translateFont failed` and drops the glyphs.

dsh-pdf solves this with a two-engine design:

@zhtx2026/dsh-pdf README · Why a custom renderer?：- **pdfjs engine** — used when *all* fonts are embedded (standard PDFs).
- **sysfont engine** — a built-in content-stream renderer that decodes the
  PDF text operators (`BT/ET`, `Tf`, `Tm`, `Td`, `Tj`, `TJ`) itself, maps
  `UniGB-UCS2-H`/UTF-16BE strings to Unicode, and draws them with **system
  fonts** (`SimSun`, `SimHei`, `Microsoft YaHei`, …) via `@napi-rs/canvas`.

@zhtx2026/dsh-pdf README · Example：```text
pdf_info("D:/Downloads/SCH_SA-V11A.pdf")
→ 3 pages, A3 landscape, jsPDF producer, 6 fonts (all non-embedded)

pdf_extract_text("D:/Downloads/SCH_SA-V11A.pdf", { page: 1 })

@zhtx2026/dsh-pdf README · Architecture：- `lib/index.js` — cordis plugin entry (`name`, `inject`, `apply`); registers
  the three tools as native tool objects (plain JSON-Schema `parameters` and
  `output` — no `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` dependency needed) and injects the
  agent guidance block (`systemPrompt.section`, order 160).
- `lib/pdf-core.js` — self-contained engine: PDF object parser, font scanner,
  pdfjs loading with fs-based `CMapReaderFactory`/`StandardFontDataFactory`
  (Node 24's global `fetch` doesn't speak `file://`), the built-in text
  extractor, and the sysfont renderer.
- `cordis.patch.yml` — the `dsh.bundle.patch` insert row.

@zhtx2026/dsh-pdf README · Limitations：- Scanned/image-only PDFs have no text layer — extraction returns nothing
  (rendering still works, as a plain image).
- The sysfont renderer assumes `Type0` CID codes equal Unicode code points
  (true for `UniGB-UCS2-H` exports); exotic CID fonts fall back to pdfjs.
- Large PDFs are parsed fully into memory.
